items.title: Workflow Lab: Build With Code on the Canvas Using the Figma Agent and Code Layers
items.excerpt: Figma walks through how a designer uses code layers and the Figma agent on the canvas to prototype and test a new feature idea with working code instead of static mockups.

items.title: In Conversation: Dylan Field and David Friedberg on the Human Role in Creating With AI
items.excerpt: Figma CEO Dylan Field and David Friedberg discuss why 'design is the new code', how to shape AI's creative output, and the human vision and judgment behind what gets made.

items.title: Chat SDK agents can now stream generative UI with json-render
items.excerpt: Vercel's @json-render/chat lets Chat SDK agents stream generative UI from one typed component catalog, rendering native cards on Slack, Teams and every Chat SDK platform.

items.title: Otherwise you're just a machine
items.excerpt: A design leader who reviews portfolios and hires designers argues AI is getting better at design, so the skills behind the work - framing, judgment, reasoning - are becoming both harder to see and more important.

items.title: AI can generate the interface. What makes it worth caring about?
items.excerpt: As AI tools generate more product UI from shared patterns, designers must decide where an experience should surprise, celebrate, or stay quiet; an AI-generated completion state uses the right components but cannot judge emotional context.

items.title: Design by numbers: is AI ruining UX or just pouring gasoline on the fire?
items.excerpt: Asking whether AI will replace UX designers is the wrong question, the author argues; LLM-driven, metrics-first design accelerates an existing habit of designing by numbers rather than understanding.

items.title: I Built an Open-Source Agent Skill to Make AI-Generated Frontends Less Generic
items.excerpt: A developer releases an open-source agent skill for Codex and Claude Code that pushes AI coding agents away from the same generic look when they build websites, steering typography, layout and visual direction.

items.title: How to keep the same character across AI video clips with reference images (Kling 3.0 Omni, MiniMax H3, Wan, Seedance)
items.excerpt: The biggest complaint about AI video is not quality but that clip two shows a different person; a practical guide to reference-image workflows for character consistency across Kling 3.0 Omni, MiniMax H3, Wan and Seedance.

items.title: Nvidia DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy makes the AI backlash seem funny
items.excerpt: Nvidia's generative-AI DLSS 5, which rewrites lighting, textures and faces in real time, arrives in Hogwarts Legacy and reignites the debate over whether AI rendering honors or overrides artists' original vision.

items.title: Dior's Christmas ad faces scathing AI allegations
items.excerpt: Despite an all-star cast and a leading director, Dior's holiday film is being picked apart by critics who say it shows signs of generative AI, in contrast to Prada's hand-crafted animated spot.

items.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details how FLUX 3 Image Klein - Qwen3-VL-4B text conditioning plus a diffusion transformer - runs faster on Blackwell GPUs with TensorRT optimisations, targeting latency in design tools, image editors and visual production workflows.

items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.excerpt: Developers direct frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra through natural language to assemble assets, connect physics and rendering, and build Omniverse simulation apps for animated 3D content and design testing.

items.title: Autodesk releases Flame 2027.2
items.excerpt: Autodesk's Flame 2027.2 update lets the compositing and finishing software import USD scenes and adds a new AI model for generating normal maps from video footage.

items.title: Chaos brings AI design exploration into Enscape
items.excerpt: Enscape 4.22 builds Veras 2.0 AI rendering directly into the Enscape interface so architects can generate design variations, materials and moods without a separate window, plus new AI video models for communicating ideas.

items.title: This AI 3D Printer Can Now Design Your Parts, Too. I Have Questions.
items.excerpt: BCN3D's Aurora printer now promises to design parts itself from a photo, a few words or a voice command, skipping CAD and slicing entirely; All3DP questions what that means for precision and design control.

items.title: IronCAD 2027 update adds design automation tools
items.excerpt: IronCAD 2027 adds AI-assisted scripting for design automation, sheet metal catalog reuse and updated CAD translators for major formats.

items.title: What MCP could mean for infrastructure AI
items.excerpt: Bentley's latest AI efforts use the Model Context Protocol to connect large language models to years of engineering know-how locked in infrastructure design data and tools.

items.title: Tencent Hunyuan 4: A Multimodal Agent for Blender, Office, and Finance
items.excerpt: Tencent's Hunyuan 4 adds vision, a 1M-token context and computer-use skills that drive Blender and CAD, building 3D scenes from sketches alongside office document work.

items.title: PH3 Image: A Fast, Small Image Model Built on MiniMax H3
items.excerpt: PH3 Image turns MiniMax H3 into a 7x smaller, 5x faster open-weight image generator; what it does and how it compares with other image models.

items.title: How to Use Claude to Edit Short-Form Videos: A Practical Workflow
items.excerpt: A step-by-step look at using Claude with skills and MCP tools such as VidIQ and ElevenLabs to script and automatically edit short-form talking-head videos.

items.title: You can edit your videos with AI on Instagram's new desktop Edits app
items.excerpt: Instagram's Edits video editor arrives on desktop as a Mac app with Meta's Muse AI able to edit Reels on the timeline, plus MCP support so outside AI agents can work in it.

items.title: Generate longer AI videos with Omni 1.2 Flash in Google Vids at no cost
items.excerpt: Google Vids gets the new Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model, letting users generate 15-second clips with consistent scenes for free.

items.title: Speed up design system documentation with the Figma agent
items.excerpt: Figma demonstrates practical ways its agent speeds up design system documentation inside Figma files.

items.title: How I Edit My Videos with Claude
items.excerpt: Igor shows how his team uses ChatGPT and Claude Design to create the animations in his videos, from a transcript to animated overlays.
